qualified_boundaries: repeated-run identity agreement below threshold removes automatic comparison eligibility
position-swap sensitivity is detected using stable candidate identity rather than left/right position
preservation failure vetoes a preferred candidate
style preference cannot override story-function preservation

authority_limit: This qualification proves the robustness analyzer over structured judge-trial evidence. It does not prove a particular model is a reliable literary judge until that model is actually run through the experiment protocol on authorized calibration material.
